about: Word lists for generated captain names (package A2, D006). A name is an adjective, a noun and a number from 10 to 99, for example Brave Puffin 17. Names appear on a projector: every word must be kind and plain. PENDING a human look (N9): Nils or the S lane reads every word before a class sees the names. One word each, letters A-Z only, first letter capital. Changing a list never renames a player.
